item.title: Ninja Slushi Deal: Here’s How to Make Yourself a Frozen Coffee Treat to Beat the Summer Heat
item.description:
[Intro music plays, followed by the host]
Host: "Hey there, it's sizzling hot outside, no matter where you are. But don't worry, we've got just the thing to keep you cool. Today, we're talking about the Ninja Slushi Professional Frozen Drink Maker. This awesome device can whip up frozen treats in just 15 minutes, no ice needed!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "The Ninja Slushi uses RapidChill Technology, which spins 360 degrees to turn liquids into slushy goodness. And the best part? It's on sale at Walmart for $298, down from $349.99. With its temperature controls and five settings, you can customize the thickness of your frozen concoctions to your heart's content."
[Short music transition]
Host: "One of our favorite recipes is a Frappe, an icy blended coffee drink made famous by coffee chains like Dunkin' and Starbucks. To make it, simply mix together half & half, black coffee, vanilla extract, and granulated sugar, and pour it into the Ninja Slushi. Then, click the Frappe preset and let the machine do its magic. Top it off with whipped cream, caramel, and mini-chips, and you're in for a treat!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "The Ninja Slushi is perfect for summertime parties, gatherings, and get-togethers. It keeps drinks frozen for up to 12 hours, so you can enjoy your favorite frozen drinks all day long. And, as a Walmart product, you can get it shipped to you for free with a Walmart+ membership or by spending over $35."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "So, stay cool this summer with the Ninja Slushi Professional Frozen Drink Maker. Get it now at Walmart and start enjoying your favorite frozen treats in no time. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!"
